research_question: Can the NSS 80 model be reduced to 15 intuitive inputs while retaining enough performance to justify a simpler form?
outer_split: Exact saved corrected v4 episode IDs.
inner_split: Exact saved full-data-comparison selection and validation episode IDs; people are disjoint.
stopping: Explicit grouped validation chooses n_iter; final estimator refits all outer-training rows with early_stopping=False.
locked_test_policy: One evaluation after feature set and stopping logic are fixed; no test-driven tuning or selection.
importance: Five seeded feature permutations on the same seed-42 sample of 4,000 inner-validation episodes; diagnostic only.
high_cost: Empirical locked-test 90th, 95th, and 99th percentiles with >= cutoff, matching the controlled comparison.
decision_rule: R2>=.40: promote if MAE/RMSE ratios versus compact25 are <=1.10 and all tail-MAE ratios <=1.15; .39-.40: promote if <=1.05 and <=1.10; .37-.39: more testing if <=1.03 and <=1.08, otherwise keep25; below .37 keep25.
